en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate corner building in historicist style with a prominent tower and decorative façade. The street scene includes pedestrians, early 20th‑century clothing, shopfronts and lampposts. The printed frame around the image is yellow with red text. On the left side it reads "Kolozsvár – Klausenburg" and on the right side vertically "New York szálloda – New‑York‑Hôtel. … 1901." The central building is identified as the New York Hotel.
